meta.name: Maeri 2024
meta.description:
Maeri revolves around the story of a mother, Tara Deshpande, who is pushed to the edge when her beloved daughter, Manasvi, is brutally assaulted by a group of influential young men. As the judicial system fails to deliver justice, Tara embarks on a dangerous, secret battle against the powerful perpetrators, using every resource and tactic at her disposal to obtain revenge. As the stakes grow higher, Tara must navigate her fractured family dynamics, face a relentless police officer, and confront her own moral boundaries. With each twist, the tension escalates, leading to a shocking final confrontation. Will Tara's pursuit of vengeance cost her everything?

As Tara and Hemant Deshpande navigate their tangled lives, the story unfolds a series of suspenseful events that force them to confront their deepest fears and choices.

Rated U/A 16+ · Ended · First aired 6 Dec 2024 · India · Language: Hindi
Studio: Zee Studios, Zenith Pictures · Network: ZEE5

videos.title: Anhoni
videos.overview: Tara and Hemant are a happy couple whose lives revolve around their daughter, Manasvi. Manasvi, a college student's life, takes a drastic turn when she refuses a proposal from her classmate, Rohit.

videos.title: Zakham
videos.overview: Rohit and his friends abduct Manasvi. On the other hand, Tara and Hemant start a search for her when she is too late. They are shocked to find Manasvi in an injured state, barely alive and breathing.

videos.title: Andha Kanoon
videos.overview: Manasvi refuses to file a complaint or fight in court, and Hemant supports her decision. While Tara fears that Manasvi’s name will dragged through the mud, she is hell-bent on seeking justice.

videos.title: Jaal
videos.overview: Tara begins a secret battle against the four criminals under the guidance of Shubhankar Pandit. Her first target, Rohit, is trapped in a scandal. Soon, Rohit and his cousin Aditya are found dead.

videos.title: Pratishodh
videos.overview: Tara sees a difference in Manasvi’s behaviour, but her fight becomes difficult when ACP Avinash takes up the case of Rohit’s death. Meanwhile, Vikram confesses to his involvement in the crime.

videos.title: Chaunauti
videos.overview: Vikram is arrested on the charges of assaulting Manasvi. He takes Varun Joshi’s name, who is the son of a renowned lawyer. Meanwhile, Varun’s father, Jayesh, calls Tara and Hemant for a settlement.

videos.title: Ant-Yudh
videos.overview: Hemant, Tara and Manasvi decide to go to a faraway place for a weekend. Tara confesses to her involvement in the crimes against Rohit and Aditya. Varun appears at the bungalow for a final showdown.
